title: But can your calculator run Linux?
summary: A hacker successfully ported Linux to run on an HP Prime G1 graphing calculator, demonstrating the extreme end of calculator hacking by replacing the native firmware with a full Linux kernel and userspace environment.
problem_solved: Demonstrates what's possible when pushing hardware beyond its intended purpose by running a full operating system on a device designed only for mathematical calculations.
why_valuable: Showcases deep hardware understanding, reverse engineering skills, and serves as inspiration for the hacking community to explore unconventional uses of everyday devices.
